name: Zinc

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: An essential trace element and cofactor for over three hundred enzymes. Sustained high-dose intake induces intestinal metallothionein and produces copper deficiency, which is the principal risk of long-term supplementation.

systems.note: Repletion of an essential trace element cofactor; the intended effect.
Sustained high intake induces copper deficiency, causing sideroblastic anaemia and neutropenia.

monitors.why: Copper deficiency is the specific, well-documented risk of sustained high-dose zinc.
Neutropenia is the haematological manifestation of zinc-induced copper deficiency.
